fact: The project 'Optimiser l'apprentissage par le numérique – Mise à l'échelle', launched 8 August 2025 and run jointly by Light for the World, UN-ABPAM and the Ministry of Secondary Education, aims to produce accessible digital teaching content and exams for 48 visually impaired pupils and 34 teachers.
